Identifier $F190h - BaselineCounter

Description
This identifier returns the BaselineCounter

Availability
Supported in the following diagnostic sessions:
- defaultSession
- extendedDiagnosticSession

Security Level:
		L0 (means no security access assurance)

Request Message:
Byte 1		$22 = Request Service Id "ReadDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F190 = BaselineCounter

Positive Response Message:
Byte 1		$62 = Response Service Id "ReadDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F190 = BaselineCounter
Byte 4		Data Record
Byte 4		counter value
		Range: 0 ~ 255 

Data Type:		Unsigned
Storage Position:	EEPROM
Size:			1 bytes
R/W State:		R
NVM Item:		NVM_ID_DCOM_BaselineCounter
Value Range:		0 ~ 255

================================================================================

Identifier $F18Ch - ModeSelector

Description
This identifier returns the ModeSelector

Availability
Supported in the following diagnostic sessions:
- defaultSession
- extendedDiagnosticSession

Security Level:
		L0 (means no security access assurance)

Request Message:
Byte 1		$22 = Request Service Id "ReadDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F18C = ModeSelector

Positive Response Message:
Byte 1		$62 = Response Service Id "ReadDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F18C = ModeSelector
Byte 4		Data Record
Byte 4		mode code
		Range: 0x00 ~ 0x02 

Data Type:		enum
Storage Position:	EEPROM
Size:			1 bytes
R/W State:		R
NVM Item:		NVM_ID_DCOM_ModeSelector
Value Range:		Enum: 0x00, 0x01, 0x02

================================================================================

Byte 4		Data Record
Byte 4		temperature
		Range: 0 ~ 100 C

Data Type:		Unsigned
Storage Position:	RAM
Size:			1 bytes
R/W State:		R
NVM Item:		
Value Range:		0 ~ 100 C

Identifier $F1A2h - RegionCode

Description
This identifier returns the RegionCode

Availability
Supported in the following diagnostic sessions:
- defaultSession
- extendedDiagnosticSession

Security Level:
		L0 (means no security access assurance)

Request Message:
Byte 1		$22 = Request Service Id "ReadDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F1A2 = RegionCode

Positive Response Message:
Byte 1		$62 = Response Service Id "ReadDataByIdentifier"
Byte 2-3	$F1A2 = RegionCode
Byte 4-5		Data Record
Byte 4-5		region
		Range: 0x00 ~ 0x03 

Data Type:		enum
Storage Position:	EEPROM
Size:			2 bytes
R/W State:		R
NVM Item:		NVM_ID_DCOM_RegionCode
Value Range:		Enum: 0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03
